title: Counit projections of an ordinary coefficient-tower fibre are locally invertible
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, the actual ell-power quotient rings A_n=O_E/(ell^(n+1)), and the published ordinary derived categories D(T) of strict semilinear varying-coefficient systems [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let b:Base ell E and o:Operations ell E b be the normalized geometric operations of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. For an arbitrary scheme Z and opens U,V, put W=U intersection V. Write r_D for the specified derived inverse image along D -> Z, R_D for its right derived direct image, and r_UD,r_VD for the inverse images to W. Use the comparisons r_W isomorphic to r_U followed by r_UW and r_V followed by r_VW obtained from o.comp and the equalities of the actual inclusion maps. For P in D(U), Q in D(V) and c:r_UW(P) isomorphic to r_VW(Q), form d=(res_U followed by R_W(c),-res_V), where res_D is the adjunction mate of the restriction of the D-counit. Given ANY distinguished triangle G --f--> R_U(P) direct-sum R_V(Q) --d--> R_W(r_VW(Q)) --> G[1], both maps r_U(f) followed by r_U(projection_1) and the U-counit, and r_V(f) followed by r_V(projection_2) and the V-counit, are invertible. No open-cover, finite-type, constructibility, cohomological or Tor hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: Use the ordinary ringed sequence-site presentation of strict varying-coefficient towers. Localize at the constant representable open subterminal for each of U,V,U intersection V. The slice equivalence identifies the base site with the small pro-etale site of the open subscheme. The coefficient ring comparisons fix constant sections and hence every quotient transition; consequently the resulting system module categories and ordinary restrictions are exactly the specified geometric ones.

Localize the additive exact module comparisons termwise. The universal properties of right adjoints identify direct images and their counits with those in Operations.geometry. The comp_termwise field fixes the comparison as the localization of ordinaryComp. The comp_evaluation equation fixes its ordinary components at every coefficient level to the canonical constant-section pullback composition; ordinary system morphisms are determined by their level components, so these are the actual nested restriction comparisons.

source.place: Gluing: normalized ordinary geometric and derived adjunctions

proof.text: Apply ringedTopos_fibre_restriction after the preceding identifications, transporting the given triangle. On U the second component of its middle map becomes -1; on V the first component is invertible after applying the overlap isomorphism. In either case the arrow is split epic, the connecting map is zero, and the fibre is the graph of the remaining component. Projection to the other summand and the invertible open counit therefore give exactly the two asserted invertible maps. This calculation does not require that the opens cover Z.

lean.statement:
theorem tower_fibre_projections
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U V : Z.Opens)
    (P : D l E U.toScheme) (Q : D l E V.toScheme)
    (c : (pull l E b (o.geometry (Z.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)))).obj P ≅
      (pull l E b (o.geometry (Z.homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)))).obj Q) :
    let compU := (o.comp (Z.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)) U.ι ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ pull l E b (o.geometry f))
        (Z.homOfLE_ι (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)))).symm
    let compV := (o.comp (Z.homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)) V.ι ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ pull l E b (o.geometry f))
        (Z.homOfLE_ι (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)))).symm
    let d := biprod.desc
      (restrictionAdjunctionMap (adjunction l E b (o.geometry U.ι))
        (adjunction l E b (o.geometry (U ⊓ V).ι)) compU P ≫
          (push l E b (o.geometry (U ⊓ V).ι)).map c.hom)
      (-restrictionAdjunctionMap (adjunction l E b (o.geometry V.ι))
        (adjunction l E b (o.geometry (U ⊓ V).ι)) compV Q)
    ∀ (G : D l E Z)
      (f : G ⟶ (push l E b (o.geometry U.ι)).obj P ⊞
        (push l E b (o.geometry V.ι)).obj Q)
      (δ : (push l E b (o.geometry (U ⊓ V).ι)).obj
        ((pull l E b (o.geometry (Z.homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)))).obj Q) ⟶
          (shiftFunctor _ (1 : ℤ)).obj G),
      Triangle.mk f d δ ∈ distTriang _ →
        IsIso ((pull l E b (o.geometry U.ι)).map f ≫
          (pull l E b (o.geometry U.ι)).map biprod.fst ≫
            (adjunction l E b (o.geometry U.ι)).counit.app P) ∧
        IsIso ((pull l E b (o.geometry V.ι)).map f ≫
          (pull l E b (o.geometry V.ι)).map biprod.snd ≫
            (adjunction l E b (o.geometry V.ι)).counit.app Q)
